Fig. 1 shows the microstructure of the solution-treated alloy. The solution-treated alloy mainly consists of equiaxed α-Mg grains with an average grain size of ~55 μm and a bit of undissolved eutectic phases at grain boundaries.

As-extruded alloy shows a typical bimodal microstructure comprising fine recrystallized grains and coarse hot-worked grains elongated along with ED. The fraction of hot-worked regions was estimated to be ~55%.
At about 28h, the as-extruded alloy reached a maximum hardness of ~106 HV, showing an increment of ~16 HV.
